observations: A large black plastic water tank with horizontal ribbing, standing outdoors on a dirt ground.
The tank has a top lid with a circular opening and a side outlet with a green cap.
Visible dirt, scratches, and some black streaks on the surface, especially on the right side.
The tank appears to be used, with no visible cracks or major structural damage.
In photo 2, a small rectangular label with 'GIPPE KERO' is visible on the side, but it is not clear if it is a brand or model.
The tank is surrounded by other similar tanks and debris, suggesting a storage or resale yard.
No visible damage to the top or lid, but the side outlet cap is missing or not fully visible in some photos.
